target_customer: Engineering teams that run several AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and need shared context
problem: Coding agent sessions are single player and their reasoning is lost, so teammates cannot see what was tried or why decisions were made.
business_model: Developer tool, pricing not stated; installed via Homebrew, likely per team subscription
product_category: Shared memory and multiplayer layer for AI coding agents

founders.name: Dorsa Rohani
founders.background_notes: Transformer implementation with over 2,400 GitHub stars; many hackathon wins per YC profile.

founders.name: Shubham Patil
education: UC San Diego (per YC bio reference to campus)
founders.background_notes: Founding engineer at Beem building multi agent systems.

competitors.name: Claude Code Agent Teams
competitors.what: Anthropic feature that lets agents in an active team see what others tried
competitors.traction_then: Narrower scope than cross session shared memory per a third party review

competitors.name: Cursor 3
competitors.what: Agent orchestration IDE with parallel agents, launched 2026-04-02; no confirmed shared session feature

technical_complexity.rationale: Capturing and syncing sessions from several agent tools and building a real time collaborative environment is standard engineering with some integration difficulty; no research breakthrough needed.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated team session history could create lock in, but model labs and IDE vendors can ship similar features quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Anthropic shipped Claude Tag, a multiplayer Claude in Slack, and Agent Teams in 2026; no direct copy of cross session memory confirmed.

market_need_then: YC listed multiplayer AI in its Fall 2026 Requests for Startups, arguing agents are mostly single player while serious work is collaborative; the company reports about 2,000 installs and 37 organizations syncing.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious category claims (defining the frontier of multiplayer AI)

branding.community_and_virality: Company says its early live coding environment went viral; no independent source confirmed. A third party review describes a Mosaic and Ocean product split.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic dictionary word shared by many companies, with no independent evidence of brand pull yet.

pivots.why: Company positioning shifted to infrastructure for people and agents to share context

outcome_analysis: Mosaic is a Summer 2026 company with two founders from ML and agent engineering backgrounds. It reports early usage but no confirmed funding, and a crowded field of model labs and IDEs makes defensibility the open question; too early for an outcome.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125K seed and an Acquired status, and VCBacked lists a 500K pre-seed dated September 2025; both single aggregator sources that conflict with the active YC profile, so unverified and not recorded as rounds. Usage numbers are company reported. Dated competitor evidence is thin.
